scope: How the Release build ends a tool run whose main_ returns an exit code and one whose main_ throws (the closing '<tool> took ...' line after the first, none after the second; the run-phase and initialisation catch texts), what reaches the -log file (writeLogInfo_, writeLogWarn_, writeLogError_ and writeDebug_ lines of the tool bodies; OPENMS_LOG_WARN/ERROR lines do not), and ToolHandler's reading of an installed manifest reached through OPENMS_TOOL_PREFIX_PATH. Tools: FileInfo, FuzzyDiff, PeakPickerHiRes, FeatureFinderCentroided, MzMLSplitter, DTAExtractor, BaselineFilter, SpectraFilterWindowMower.
method: TOPPBase.cpp and ToolHandler.cpp read at the cli pin, the tool sources at the topp pin, with git show. 28 cases executed against the C++ Release build by ../oracle/topp-exception-exits/cases.sh on ibminode06 in a clean environment per case (env -i, per-case HOME, OPENMS_HOME_PATH and cwd, OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON, OPENMS_DATA_PATH pinned), twice (run1 with 25 cases, run2 with all 28); the 25 common cases are identical between the runs after masking paths, time stamps and timing figures. run2 is retained under tests/data/topp_exception_exits and replayed through tests/support/release_runs.rs, which maps the Release run's paths to the replay's, drops the Linux stty probe line before a usage text, checks the closing line by shape and masks log time stamps; everything else is compared as recorded. The inputs are copies of files under tests/data (inputs.sha256 holds the oracle's hashes, equal to the repository files'); the profile FeatureFinderCentroided input is derived in the test and checked by its SHA-1.
evidence_tier: oracle-generated (tier 1 executed differential) against the Release build; the recorded differences (a directory as -in on the Linux Release build; a copy of the installed manifest under another prefix) are asserted as such.
external_reference_note: The oracle driver, its inputs and both result trees live under ../oracle/topp-exception-exits; the run2 case directories the tests replay are retained under tests/data/topp_exception_exits, with their hashes in fixtures.sha256.json there.
